name: promotekit
label: PromoteKit
description: Affiliate marketing platform integrated with Stripe.

apiKey.label: API Key
apiKey.description:
To get your API key:
1. Log in to your PromoteKit dashboard.
2. Go to **Settings > API Keys**.
3. Click **Create API Key**.
4. Copy the key and paste it here.

list_affiliates.label: List Affiliates
list_affiliates.description: List the affiliates in your PromoteKit account, one page at a time.

page.label: Page
page.description: Page number to retrieve. Defaults to 1.

limit.label: Limit
limit.description: Number of affiliates per page (max 100). Defaults to 10.

find_affiliate.label: Find Affiliate
find_affiliate.description: Get details of a specific affiliate by ID.

affiliate_id.label: Affiliate
affiliate_id.description: The ID of the affiliate to retrieve.

create_affiliate.label: Create Affiliate
create_affiliate.description: Create a new affiliate in PromoteKit.

email.label: Email
email.description: The email address of the new affiliate.

campaign_id.label: Campaign
campaign_id.description: Select the campaign for this affiliate.

update_affiliate.label: Update Affiliate
update_affiliate.description: Update an existing affiliate in PromoteKit.

affiliate_id.label: Affiliate

payout_email.label: Payout Email

list_campaigns.label: List Campaigns
list_campaigns.description: List the campaigns in your PromoteKit account, up to 100.
list_campaigns.afterResponse:
const flattenCampaign = (campaign) => ({ id: campaign.id, name: campaign.name, commission_type: campaign.commission_type ?? null, commission_amount: campaign.commission_amount ?? null });
return response.data.map(flattenCampaign);

find_campaign.label: Find Campaign
find_campaign.description: Get details of a specific campaign by ID.

campaign_id.label: Campaign
campaign_id.description: The ID of the campaign to retrieve.

find_campaign.afterResponse:
const flattenCampaign = (campaign) => ({ id: campaign.id, name: campaign.name, commission_type: campaign.commission_type ?? null, commission_amount: campaign.commission_amount ?? null });
return flattenCampaign(response.data);

new_affiliate_event.label: New Affiliate Event
new_affiliate_event.description: Triggers when a PromoteKit affiliate event is received. Copy the trigger's address into your PromoteKit dashboard: **Settings > Webhooks > Add Endpoint**, then enable the affiliate event types you chose and save the endpoint.

eventTypes.label: Affiliate Event Types
eventTypes.description: The affiliate event types to listen for, as a JSON list of: affiliate.created, affiliate.approved. Leave empty to receive all affiliate events.

new_referral_event.label: New Referral Event
new_referral_event.description: Triggers when a PromoteKit referral webhook event is received. Copy the trigger's address into your PromoteKit dashboard: **Settings > Webhooks > Add Endpoint**, then enable the referral event types you chose and save the endpoint.

eventTypes.label: Referral Event Types
eventTypes.description: The referral event types to listen for, as a JSON list of: referral.created, referral.converted. Leave empty to receive all referral events.

new_commission_event.label: New Commission Event
new_commission_event.description: Triggers when a PromoteKit commission webhook event is received. Copy the trigger's address into your PromoteKit dashboard: **Settings > Webhooks > Add Endpoint**, then enable the **Commission Created** event and save the endpoint.
